popCulture.title: Theogony (Demeter and Iasion)
popCulture.creator: Hesiod
popCulture.description: Hesiod’s Theogony tells how Demeter lay with Iasion in a thrice-ploughed field and bore Plutus — until Zeus struck the Samothracian lover with a thunderbolt.

popCulture.title: Odyssey V (Calypso on Demeter and Iasion)
popCulture.creator: Homer
popCulture.description: Calypso cites Demeter’s love for Iasion among the gods’ harsh jealousy of goddesses who take mortal partners — Homer’s brief dossier of the thunderbolt death.
